insertText.text: The water network for Europe
A premium, zero-emission water layer — in your app, on your wallet.
THE REGION
Europe & the Gulf: water-bound mobility markets
Bolt already owns the demand from the Aegean to the Gulf; the water leg books door-to-door beside every Bolt car.
Greece — the recommended beachhead
Bolt's deepest island demand and longest season — replacing slow diesel ferries.
Croatia — the Dalmatian island chain
High-volume Adriatic island hops — Split, Hvar, Brač and Korčula on one network.
Riviera — Nice to Monaco by water
Premium corporate and leisure demand — skip Corniche traffic with a silent foiling run.
A new multi-billion-dollar vertical across Europe
Read it bottom-up: the fare a Navier boat collects today, the market a faster product unlocks — then the whole journey a super-app monetizes around every crossing.
Today — Navier fares on Bolt's network, serving 10% of current trips
Near term — faster, quieter boats grow the market, serving 25% at maturity
Full market — the entire sea-transfer market we create (range $4.5–15.8B)
Whole journey — add food, stays and experiences to every crossing
Bolt's revenue on Navier — 18% of every journey across the full network
You bring the demand. We operate the water.

▸  Bolt — demand, the app, the wallet and the brand.
▸  Navier — vessels, crew, maintenance, certification and the network playbook.
▸  Together — a premium foiling water tier from the Aegean to the Gulf.

1.  Working session — walk through the presentation and Navier atlas. 
2.  Vessel demo — a live foiling run on a pilot corridor. 
3.  Pilot MOU — Greece beachhead, three corridors, 12-month launch window.
Explore the Bolt marine network
Open the Navier × Bolt Atlas, pick the first corridor, and let's discover a new foiling water tier across Europe.
Italy — Amalfi, Capri & the lagoon
Amalfi Coast day-trips, Capri crossings and Venice lagoon hops on one supply standard.
UAE — Dubai & Abu Dhabi by water
Premium harbour-to-harbour demand — no Sheikh Zayed Road required.
Saudi — Jeddah & the Red Sea
PIF waterfront ambition meets water mobility
Greece — Cyclades island network
Mykonos, Paros, Naxos and Santorini — the highest-volume Aegean hops.
Croatia — Dubrovnik & the islands
Elaphiti Islands, Korčula and Mljet — premium Adriatic excursions.
